open_items: ILO gateway-metadata-only 403 flap (new shape): second occurrence, cycle 586 (2026-09-12T00:01:22Z, gateway metadata 403 Forbidden on dataflow listing, 2 attempts; gateway data, direct metadata, direct data, direct json all passed same cycle; no contract rows affected). Resolved by cycle 587, confirmed still healthy through cycle 589; see the 2026-09-12T06:43Z report entry. First occurrence was cycle 526, resolved by cycle 527, confirmed healthy through cycle 571. Both occurrences resolved within one cycle. Watch for a third occurrence; escalate for real if it stretches past two to three cycles.

OECD direct-data-only ReadTimeout flap (new shape): first occurrence, cycle 566 (2026-09-10T08:01:22Z, direct data: ReadTimeout, gateway metadata/data and direct metadata/json all passed same cycle). Resolved by cycle 567, confirmed still healthy through cycle 589. No prior occurrence of this specific shape found in incidents.md; distinct from the cycles 290-292 OECD gateway_issue 403 episode. Watch for a second occurrence.

ILO gateway-data-only 403 flap (standalone): third occurrence, cycle 562 (gateway data: probe status: error; HTTP 403 from provider; gateway metadata passed but slow, 2 attempts/4470ms; direct metadata, direct data, direct json all passed). Resolved by cycle 563 (one cycle), confirmed still healthy through cycle 589. Prior occurrences: cycle 370 (resolved by 371) and cycle 322 (tail end of the cycle 321 blanket-403 episode), both also resolved within one to two cycles. All three occurrences now follow the same fast-resolution pattern. Distinct from the broader both-metadata-and-data or blanket-403 episodes (cycles 384, 396-411, 442, 490-493, 526). Watch for a fourth occurrence; escalate for real if a future occurrence stretches past two to three cycles.

ECB has flapped three times in under 24 hours, each with a distinct failure shape, after weeks of clean history: (1) cycle 535 (2026-09-07T18:01:22Z) whole-provider HTTP 503 outage, every check failing, resolved by cycle 536; (2) cycle 539 (2026-09-08T02:01:22Z) gateway-data 504 + direct-json ReadTimeout, resolved by cycle 540; (3) cycle 542 (2026-09-08T08:01:22Z) gateway-data network/transport error ("provider unreachable") + direct-metadata ReadTimeout, resolved by cycle 543. No two episodes share the same failing-check combination. Each self-resolved within one cycle; confirmed healthy through cycle 589 (no further occurrence). Distinct from the cycle 199 ECB metadata-only 503, the contract-only 504 flaps at cycles 182-183 and 283-286, and the old HTTP 406 Accept-header issue fixed before cycle 44. No fourth occurrence yet; keep watching, but the rate-change concern has not recurred in the last 23 cycles.

ILO contract-only blanket 403 (new shape): second occurrence, started cycle 490, resolved by cycle 493 at the latest. First occurrence was cycle 418, resolved by the next cycle. No third occurrence through cycle 589. Watch for a third occurrence.

ILO blanket-403 provider_down episode: eleventh occurrence, started cycle 442, resolved by cycle 443 (one cycle), confirmed still healthy (basic checks) through cycle 589; cycle 562's episode was the narrower gateway-data-only shape (resolved by cycle 563), not this blanket pattern. Matches the usual one-to-two-cycle resolution pattern (244, 251, 260, 264, 272, 281, 321, 382, 412); only the ninth occurrence (cycles 396-411) ran long. No cause has ever been confirmed for any occurrence. Watch for a twelfth occurrence.
IMF provider_down flap: first occurrence, cycle 419, resolved by cycle 420. No second occurrence through cycle 589. Watch for a second occurrence.

ESTAT list_dataflows timeout pattern: twenty-eighth occurrence cycle 505, resolved by cycle 506, stable healthy through cycle 589. Standing recommendation (raise deadline, stream listing, or cache parsed result in monitor/checks_gateway.py) remains open as a code-change-scope fix, not actioned by this read-only routine. Watch for a twenty-ninth occurrence.
